messages.author: ca6547b023c013bf
messages.subject: Any experience with getting INLA to work on Posit Cloud?
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to run INLA on Posit Cloud, and getting the following kind of errors (repeated any tmes 

inla.mkl: /lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/libc.so.6: version `GLIBC_2.38' not found (required by /cloud/lib/renv/cache/v5/linux-ubuntu-focal/R-4.4/x86_64-pc-linux-gnu/INLA/25.06.07/387453fb505cb274e698329f95abd399/INLA/bin/linux/64bit/libcap.so.2)

Do you have any advice on how to get INLA working on Posit Cloud?
Best wishes,
Robbie

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Any experience with getting INLA to work on Posit Cloud?
parts:
please upgrade to testing version

inla.upgrade(testing=TRUE)

restart R

library(INLA)
inla.binary.install()

choose CentOS7

let me know if that does not work

best
H
